messages:
Rae: quick thread — product ask from two enterprise customers: auditable export + keystore escrow options. need deterministic decision by EOW.
Miguel: can we scope minimal acceptance? customers want an "attestation" with export that includes chain-of-custody and a signed manifest.
Priya: draft acceptance for MVP: searchable warm window = 21d, export package includes manifest.json + zipped events, signed by our key, export time SLA < 24h for 250k events.
Miguel: infra note: 21d warm index costs ~0.6x current footprint. full 3yr index unrealistic without tiered index. propose sampled index for cold lane.
Rae: keystore options: (A) host-managed (no plaintext stored), (B) BYOK handshake + escrow option for legal review. customers asking for escrow so legal holds can be satisfied.
legal-bot: legal: escrow is OK but requires explicit contract language around key escrow access workflow and logging. attestation must include signer identity and digest algorithm.
Priya: rollout proposal: Q2 ship export-attestation + 21d warm search; Q3 expand archival export + escrow flow + rotation API.
Miguel: perf snapshot from infra-bot:
```
infra-bot: search p95=1.3s on 6 indexers for 21d warm, export prototype for 100k events = 12m (need tuning)
```
Rae: decision ask: greenlight Q2 export-attestation + resource ask for one infra contractor to tune export pipeline.
Priya: +1. will draft SLA language and contract addendum.
Miguel: +1 pending cost delta. I'll send cost delta by EOD.
legal-bot: noted. will draft escrow clause sample.
Rae: ok locking. follow-ups: Priya -> SLA + addendum; Miguel -> cost delta + infra hiring ticket; Rae -> sales alignment and customer comms. infra-bot: created epic PROD-9999 (export-attestation)
